1: Vertical composition. A narrow Roman street in the early morning of 1962, warm low sunlight down the length of it and long shadows. A thin boy of fifteen in a worn jacket too big at the shoulders stands in the middle of the empty street facing the camera, holding a brown paper parcel the size of a shoebox against his chest with both arms, looking down at a torn piece of card in his fingers. His face and the parcel are the brightest things in the frame; shuttered shops recede into cool shadow on both sides.
